blurb: Flying Lady Boat Tours offers narrated sightseeing boat tours including historic and celebrity home tours, sunset cruises, and sandbar and swim experiences. Tours depart from Guanabanas in Jupiter and Riviera Beach Marina in West Palm Beach. Wildlife sightings may include manatees, turtles, dolphins, and coastal birds.
extraNote: No booking fees; online booking available · Tours operate rain or shine; weather policies detailed on FAQ · Cancellation and refund policies available on FAQ page · Departures from Guanabanas (Jupiter) and Riviera Beach Marina (West Palm Beach)

quotes.author: Timothy Sherman
quotes.text: The excursion was amazing. Bailey was an excellent guide, very knowledgeable. Captain Rob was a fantastic boat driver. Even though the ponies weren't being very cooperative and coming into view for us. Overall an amazing adventure.Owner's replyThank you, Timothy! We're thrilled you enjoyed the excursion with Bailey and Captain Rob! Sometimes the ponies have their own schedules, but we're glad the adventure still felt amazing. We hope to see you again! 🐾⛵

quotes.author: Tamara Hartzell
quotes.text: Great tour! Very knowledgeable of the area. Our Captian Rob and narrator Bailey were phenomenal. They were very interactive with the guests. Great experience and highly recommend.Owner's replyThanks so much, Tamara! We're thrilled you enjoyed the tour with Captain Rob and Bailey—they're amazing! 😊 Your recommendation means a lot. Hope to see you on another adventure soon!

This was a great tour!! Bailey was very knowledgeable and a fun tour guide! Learned a lot about the area and was a very enjoyable experience!Owner's replyThanks, Stacey & Kevin! quotes.author: Missy Gidwani
quotes.text: Fantastic!! Great crew, great tour… saw ponies! Baley was exceptional!!! Would give 6 stars if we couldOwner's replyThanks so much, Missy! We're thrilled you had such a fantastic time and got to see the ponies! 🐴 We'll make sure Baley knows they made your experience extra special. Come back anytime for more adventures!

quotes.author: T R
quotes.text: Great experience! All around pleasant, relaxing, and family friendly! Wonderful and informative crew! Beautiful wildlife!Owner's replyThanks, T! We're so glad you had a relaxing and enjoyable time. Hearing that you loved the wildlife and found the crew informative means a lot to us. Hope to see you again! 😊

quotes.author: Ashley Goodwill
quotes.text: Great tour! Guides were friendly and knowledgeable. Very patient with questions from my 6 year old.Owner's replyThanks, Ashley! We're so glad you and your 6-year-old had a great time. 😊 Our guides love engaging with curious minds—hope to see you both again on another adventure!
